title: VTA Calendar — Export — payload
description: A client exports the principal's calendar as iCalendar, together with the receipts the VTA keeps — what the member takes with them, whether or not any community still answers. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

contextIds.description: Only these contexts. Absent: every context the caller has standing in (VTI-CAL-002).

from.description: Only entries ending after this. Absent: no lower bound.

to.description: Only entries starting before this. Absent: no upper bound.

cursor.description: An opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, for the same caller and filters; the VTA refuses one it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the VTA chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTA Calendar — Export — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/calendar/export/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/calendar/export/0.1#response.

ics.description: An iCalendar (RFC 5545) object of the `mine` entries in range, titles, times and place summaries, never access details or registrants (VTI-CAL-053). The same on every page.

receipts.description: One page of the kept receipts in range, as received (VTI-CAL-030).

nextCursor.description: Present when more items remain; absent on the last page.
